statement: Terraform, Bicep, Pulumi, ARM templates and Ansible keep their own definition of each machine. This migration makes these changes, and those definitions do not know about them: The size of the machine changes. A move to v6 or v7 changes the disk controller from SCSI to NVMe. A move can change accelerated networking. A move can change the disk type to Standard SSD or Premium SSD. A rollback or a restore puts the machine on new disks, made from its safety copies. A restore can keep the disk names. The next apply can undo these changes, or replace the machine. Reconcile your definitions after the migration.
